description: O36 RULED S477: a choice `@flag ? [1, 2, 3] : []` into `int[1..=2, append]` — every branch a literal outside the length bound — provably breaks the invariant whichever branch runs: E-WRITE-INVARIANT at compile time.
rationale: §66.11.7 (O36 RULED S477): "a write that PROVABLY violates a sequence invariant … stays a compile error (`E-WRITE-INVARIANT`)". Every branch of the choice is a literal whose length the bound excludes, so the write breaks the bound whichever branch runs.
